```
public class CompatibilityOptions implements Cloneable
```

Contient les options de compatibilité (c'est‑à‑dire les préférences utilisateur saisies dans l'onglet **Compatibility** de la boîte de dialogue **Options** de Microsoft Word).

Pour en savoir plus, consultez l'article de documentation [ Detect File Format and Check Format Compatibility ][Detect File Format and Check Format Compatibility].

 **Examples:** 

Montre comment optimiser le document pour différentes versions de Microsoft Word.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 /// 
 /// Groups all flags in a document's compatibility options object by state, then prints each group.
 ///

     addOptionName(options.getUICompat97To2003(), "UICompat97To2003", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUlTrailSpace(), "UlTrailSpace", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUnderlineTabInNumList(), "UnderlineTabInNumList", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(), "UseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAnsiKerningPairs(), "UseAnsiKerningPairs", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);

     addOptionName(options.getUseNormalStyleForList(), "UseNormalStyleForList", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);

     addOptionName(options.getWPJustification(), "WPJustification", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPSpaceWidth(), "WPSpaceWidth", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWrapTrailSpaces(), "WrapTrailSpaces", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");
     for (String optionName : disabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
 }

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);
     else
         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
 }
```

Montre comment définir une spécification de conformité OOXML à laquelle un document enregistré doit se conformer.

```

 Document doc = new Document();
 DocumentBuilder builder = new DocumentBuilder(doc);

 // If we configure compatibility options to comply with Microsoft Word 2003,
 // inserting an image will define its shape using VML.
 doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2003);
 builder.insertImage(getImageDir() + "Transparent background logo.png");

 Assert.assertEquals(ShapeMarkupLanguage.VML, ((Shape) doc.getChild(NodeType.SHAPE, 0, true)).getMarkupLanguage());

 // The "ISO/IEC 29500:2008" OOXML standard does not support VML shapes.
 // If we set the "Compliance" property of the SaveOptions object to "OoxmlCompliance.Iso29500_2008_Strict",
 // any document we save while passing this object will have to follow that standard.
 OoxmlSaveOptions saveOptions = new OoxmlSaveOptions();
 saveOptions.setCompliance(OoxmlCompliance.ISO_29500_2008_STRICT);
 saveOptions.setSaveFormat(SaveFormat.DOCX);

 doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "OoxmlSaveOptions.Iso29500Strict.docx", saveOptions);

 // Our saved document defines the shape using DML to adhere to the "ISO/IEC 29500:2008" OOXML standard.
 doc = new Document(getArtifactsDir() + "OoxmlSaveOptions.Iso29500Strict.docx");

 Assert.assertEquals(ShapeMarkupLanguage.DML, ((Shape) doc.getChild(NodeType.SHAPE, 0, true)).getMarkupLanguage());
 
```

Montre comment aligner verticalement le texte d'une zone de texte.

```

 Document doc = new Document();
 DocumentBuilder builder = new DocumentBuilder(doc);

 Shape shape = builder.insertShape(ShapeType.TEXT_BOX, 200.0, 200.0);

 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Top" to
 // align the text in this text box with the top side of the shape.
 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Middle" to
 // align the text in this text box to the center of the shape.
 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Bottom" to
 // align the text in this text box to the bottom of the shape.
 shape.getTextBox().setVerticalAnchor(verticalAnchor);

 builder.moveTo(shape.getFirstParagraph());
 builder.write("Hello world!");

 // The vertical aligning of text inside text boxes is available from Microsoft Word 2007 onwards.
 doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2007);
 doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "Shape.VerticalAnchor.docx");
 
```

| [setDoNotWrapTextWithPunct(boolean value)](#setDoNotWrapTextWithPunct-boolean) | Ne pas autoriser la ponctuation suspendue avec la grille de caractères. |
| [setFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8(boolean value)](#setFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8-boolean) | Émuler le placement des notes de bas de page de Word 6.x/95/97. |
| [setForgetLastTabAlignment(boolean value)](#setForgetLastTabAlignment-boolean) | Ignorer la largeur du dernier arrêt de tabulation lors de l'alignement du paragraphe s'il n'est pas aligné à gauche. |
| [setGrowAutofit(boolean value)](#setGrowAutofit-boolean) | Autoriser les tableaux à s'ajuster automatiquement aux marges de la page. |
| [setLayoutRawTableWidth(boolean value)](#setLayoutRawTableWidth-boolean) | Ignorer l'espace avant le tableau lors de la décision si le tableau doit envelopper l'objet flottant. |
| [setLayoutTableRowsApart(boolean value)](#setLayoutTableRowsApart-boolean) | Autoriser les lignes de tableau à envelopper les objets en ligne de manière indépendante. |
| [setLineWrapLikeWord6(boolean value)](#setLineWrapLikeWord6-boolean) | Émuler le retour à la ligne de Word 6.0 pour le texte est-asiatique. |
| [setMWSmallCaps(boolean value)](#setMWSmallCaps-boolean) | Émuler le format Small Caps de Word 5.x pour le Macintosh. |
| [setNoColumnBalance(boolean value)](#setNoColumnBalance-boolean) | Ne pas équilibrer les colonnes de texte dans une section. |
| [setNoExtraLineSpacing(boolean value)](#setNoExtraLineSpacing-boolean) | Ne pas centrer le contenu sur les lignes avec une hauteur de ligne exacte. |
| [setNoLeading(boolean value)](#setNoLeading-boolean) | Ne pas ajouter d’interligne entre les lignes de texte. |
| [setNoSpaceRaiseLower(boolean value)](#setNoSpaceRaiseLower-boolean) | Ne pas augmenter la hauteur de ligne pour le texte en exposant/indice. |
| [setNoTabHangInd(boolean value)](#setNoTabHangInd-boolean) | Ne pas créer de tabulation personnalisée pour le retrait suspendu. |
| [setOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification(boolean value)](#setOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification-boolean) | Spécifie comment la hiérarchie des styles du document est évaluée. |
| [setPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader(boolean value)](#setPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader-boolean) | Imprimer le texte principal avant le contenu de l’en-tête/pied de page. |
| [setPrintColBlack(boolean value)](#setPrintColBlack-boolean) | Imprimer les couleurs en noir et blanc sans tramage. |
| [setSelectFldWithFirstOrLastChar(boolean value)](#setSelectFldWithFirstOrLastChar-boolean) | Sélectionner le champ lorsque le premier ou le dernier caractère est sélectionné. |
| [setShapeLayoutLikeWW8(boolean value)](#setShapeLayoutLikeWW8-boolean) | Émuler le texte de Word 97 qui s’enroule autour des objets flottants. |
| [setShowBreaksInFrames(boolean value)](#setShowBreaksInFrames-boolean) | Afficher les sauts de page/colonne présents dans les cadres. |
| [setSpaceForUL(boolean value)](#setSpaceForUL-boolean) | Ajouter un espace supplémentaire sous la ligne de base pour le texte asiatique souligné. |
| [setSpacingInWholePoints(boolean value)](#setSpacingInWholePoints-boolean) | N’étendre/condensser le texte que par points entiers. |
| [setSplitPgBreakAndParaMark(boolean value)](#setSplitPgBreakAndParaMark-boolean) | Toujours déplacer le marqueur de paragraphe vers la page après un saut de page. |
| [setSubFontBySize(boolean value)](#setSubFontBySize-boolean) | Augmenter la priorité de la taille de police lors de la substitution de police. |
| [setSuppressBottomSpacing(boolean value)](#setSuppressBottomSpacing-boolean) | Ignorer la hauteur de ligne exacte pour la dernière ligne de la page. |
| [setSuppressSpBfAfterPgBrk(boolean value)](#setSuppressSpBfAfterPgBrk-boolean) | Ne pas utiliser d’espace avant sur la première ligne après un saut de page. |
| [setSuppressSpacingAtTopOfPage(boolean value)](#setSuppressSpacingAtTopOfPage-boolean) | Ignorer la hauteur de ligne minimale pour la première ligne de la page. |
| [setSuppressTopSpacing(boolean value)](#setSuppressTopSpacing-boolean) | Ignorer la hauteur de ligne minimale et exacte pour la première ligne de la page. |
| [setSuppressTopSpacingWP(boolean value)](#setSuppressTopSpacingWP-boolean) | Émuler l’interligne de WordPerfect 5.x. |
| [setSwapBordersFacingPgs(boolean value)](#setSwapBordersFacingPgs-boolean) | Échanger les bordures de paragraphe sur les pages impaires. |
| [setSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning(boolean value)](#setSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning-boolean) | Spécifie d’échanger l’intérieur et l’extérieur pour les retraits en miroir et le positionnement relatif. |
| [setTransparentMetafiles(boolean value)](#setTransparentMetafiles-boolean) | Spécifie de ne pas blanchir la zone derrière les images métafichier. |
| [setTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6(boolean value)](#setTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6-boolean) | Émuler le calcul de la hauteur de police de WordPerfect 6.x. |
| [setUICompat97To2003(boolean value)](#setUICompat97To2003-boolean) | Vrai pour désactiver les fonctionnalités UI qui ne sont pas compatibles avec Word97-2003. |
| [setUlTrailSpace(boolean value)](#setUlTrailSpace-boolean) | Souligner tous les espaces de fin. |
| [setUnderlineTabInNumList(boolean value)](#setUnderlineTabInNumList-boolean) | Souligner le caractère suivant après la numérotation. |
| [setUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(boolean value)](#setUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules-boolean) | Utiliser un jeu alternatif de règles de césure pour les langues d'Asie de l'Est. |
| [setUseAnsiKerningPairs(boolean value)](#setUseAnsiKerningPairs-boolean) | Utiliser les paires de crénage ANSI provenant des polices. |
| [setUseFELayout(boolean value)](#setUseFELayout-boolean) | Ne pas contourner le code de mise en page des langues d'Asie de l'Est/complexes. |
| [setUseNormalStyleForList(boolean value)](#setUseNormalStyleForList-boolean) | Ne pas appliquer automatiquement le style de paragraphe de liste au texte à puces/numéroté. |
| [setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value)](#setUsePrinterMetrics-boolean) | Utiliser les métriques de l'imprimante pour afficher les documents. |
| [setUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells(boolean value)](#setUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells-boolean) | Utiliser des règles simplifiées pour les conflits de bordure de tableau. |
| [setUseWord2002TableStyleRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord2002TableStyleRules-boolean) | Émuler les règles de style de tableau de Word 2002. |
| [setUseWord2010TableStyleRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord2010TableStyleRules-boolean) | Spécifie d'utiliser les règles de style de tableau de Word2010. |
| [setUseWord97LineBreakRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord97LineBreakRules-boolean) | Émuler la césure d'Asie de l'Est de Word 97. |
| [setWPJustification(boolean value)](#setWPJustification-boolean) | Émuler la justification de paragraphe de WordPerfect 6.x. |
| [setWPSpaceWidth(boolean value)](#setWPSpaceWidth-boolean) | Spécifie s'il faut définir la largeur d'un espace comme c'est le cas dans WordPerfect 5.x. |
| [setWrapTrailSpaces(boolean value)](#setWrapTrailSpaces-boolean) | Retour à la ligne des espaces de fin. |

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");

         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);

         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
```

Autorisez les colonnes de tableau à dépasser les largeurs préférées des cellules constituantes.

 **Remarks:** 

L'option s'appelle "Use Word 2003 table autofit rules" dans l'interface utilisateur de MS Word 2013. Elle affecte en fait la façon dont la grille est calculée pour les tableaux à mise en page fixe, aussi (dans certains cas).

```
     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
```

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");
```

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
```

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
```

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

### getUICompat97To2003() {#getUICompat97To2003}
```
public boolean getUICompat97To2003()
```


Vrai pour désactiver les fonctionnalités UI qui ne sont pas compatibles avec Word97-2003. La valeur par défaut est false.

 **Remarks:** 

Contrôle le paramètre de compatibilité Word97-2003 qui désactive les fonctionnalités UI qui ne sont pas compatibles avec Word97-2003. Lorsque true, l'élément XML 'w:uiCompat97To2003' est écrit dans la partie du package de document '\\word\\settings.xml'. La valeur par défaut est false. Lorsqu'il est réglé sur false, cet élément n'est pas écrit. Techniquement, cette propriété ne fait pas partie des options de compatibilité, mais nous l'avons placée ici pour la commodité de l'API.

```
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
```

### getUsePrinterMetrics() {#getUsePrinterMetrics}
```
public boolean getUsePrinterMetrics()
```


Utiliser les métriques de l'imprimante pour afficher les documents.

 **Remarks:** 

Les métriques de l'imprimante peuvent différer selon les pilotes utilisés. Par exemple, Windows "Microsoft OpenXPS Class Driver 2" et "Microsoft Print to PDF" fournissent des métriques légèrement différentes. Par conséquent, la mise en page du document final peut changer si cette option est activée.

 **Examples:** 

Montre comment optimiser le document pour différentes versions de Microsoft Word.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

```
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

### setUICompat97To2003(boolean value) {#setUICompat97To2003-boolean}
```
public void setUICompat97To2003(boolean value)
```


Vrai pour désactiver les fonctionnalités UI qui ne sont pas compatibles avec Word97-2003. La valeur par défaut est false.

 **Remarks:** 

Contrôle le paramètre de compatibilité Word97-2003 qui désactive les fonctionnalités UI qui ne sont pas compatibles avec Word97-2003. Lorsque true, l'élément XML 'w:uiCompat97To2003' est écrit dans la partie du package de document '\\word\\settings.xml'. La valeur par défaut est false. Lorsqu'il est réglé sur false, cet élément n'est pas écrit. Techniquement, cette propriété ne fait pas partie des options de compatibilité, mais nous l'avons placée ici pour la commodité de l'API.

 **Examples:**

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
```

### setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value) {#setUsePrinterMetrics-boolean}
```
public void setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value)
```


Utiliser les métriques de l'imprimante pour afficher les documents.

 **Remarks:** 

Les métriques de l'imprimante peuvent différer selon les pilotes utilisés. Par exemple, Windows "Microsoft OpenXPS Class Driver 2" et "Microsoft Print to PDF" fournissent des métriques légèrement différentes. Par conséquent, la mise en page du document final peut changer si cette option est activée.

 **Examples:** 

Montre comment optimiser le document pour différentes versions de Microsoft Word.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```

```
 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
```
